name: BADM 3201
title: Intermediate Accounting I
description: (Also offered as ACCT 3201.) An in-depth study of financial accounting, giving particular emphasis to balance sheet valuations and their relationship to income determination.
requirement_description: ACCT 2101 or BADM 2710; ECON 1200, or ECON 1201 and 1202, or ARE 1150 and ECON 1202; open only to non-Business students of junior or higher status. May not be taken out of sequence after passing ACCT or BADM 3202.
